description: This Java class defines a RecyclerView.ViewHolder named ShareViewHolder used for displaying share items in an Android app. It handles binding of share data, setting avatar images, and configuring UI elements based on share types and user permissions.

classes.name: ShareViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder that displays share information, including avatar, name, and permissions, and handles user interactions.

methods.name: ShareViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewHolder with binding, account, and context.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds share data and listener to the ViewHolder, updating UI elements based on share type and user permissions.

methods.name: setPermissionName
methods.description: Sets the permission name text view visibility and text based on provided permission string.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Loads the avatar image into an ImageView, falling back to a default resource in case of an error.
